name: Apple AirPods Max Wireless Over-Ear Headphones
description: Apple-designed dynamic driver provides high-fidelity audio. Active Noise Cancellation blocks outside noise, so you can immerse yourself in music. Transparency mode for hearing and interacting with the world around you. Spatial audio with dynamic head tracking provides theater-like sound that surrounds you.

specs.name: Battery Life
specs.value: Up to 20 Hours with ANC on

name: Logitech MX Mechanical Wireless Tactile Keyboard
description: Logitech's lowest-profile mechanical keyboard switches offer next-level typing feel. Choose tactile quiet brown switches, linear red, or clicky blue. The keys light up automatically when your hands approach, adjusting to light conditions.

specs.name: Battery
specs.value: Up to 15 Days (10 Months off backlight)

name: Herschel Heritage Backpack Laptop Sleeve 21.5L
description: A classic design tailored for everyday use. Featuring the signature striped fabric liner, a padded 15-inch laptop sleeve, front storage pocket with key clip, and comfortable contoured shoulder straps. Ideal for work, travel, or class.

specs.name: Laptop Compartment
specs.value: Padded sleeve fits up to 15" Laptop

name: Philips Hue Go Portable Smart Ambient LED Lamp
description: Carry your light with you. Plug it in for millions of colors and warm white light, or use as a cordless centerpiece with the built-in rechargeable battery. Controllable via Bluetooth app, Zigbee hub, or Alexa voice controls.

specs.name: Control Options
specs.value: App Control, Hue Bridge, Voice Control

name: Hydro Flask Wide Mouth Bottle with Flex Straw Cap
description: TempShield double-wall vacuum insulation keeps cold beverages ice-cold for 24 hours, and hot drinks piping hot for 12. Leakproof straw cap allows easy sipping. Pro-grade 18/8 stainless steel construction ensures taste integrity.

name: Seiko Men's Essentials Chronograph Quartz Watch
description: Sporty chronograph function with sub-dials measuring split seconds, seconds, and minutes. Encased in a 40mm stainless steel case with scratch-resistant Hardlex crystal and a full-grain Italian leather strap. Water depth up to 100 meters.

name: Vitruvi Stone Ultrasonic Essential Oil Diffuser
description: Crafted from hand-poured porcelain ceramic cover. Operates silently using ultrasonic waves at 2.4MHz. Sleek dimmable LED accent band creates a relaxing mood. Offers a continuous 4-hour run time or 8-hour intermittent misting.

name: Wacaco Minipresso GR Portable Espresso Machine
description: Minipresso GR is your best choice to enjoy authentic espresso on the go. Compact, lightweight and sturdy, it uses ground coffee to deliver up to 8 bars of pressure using a hand pump. No electricity or batteries required.

name: Fujifilm Instax Mini 12 Instant Film Camera
description: Capture memories instantly. The Instax Mini 12 features automatic exposure and flash controls, so you can just point and shoot. Built-in selfie mirror and close-up lens capability makes portrait captures simple and fun.

name: Tempur-Pedic Ergonomic Memory Foam Seat Cushion
description: Relieve sitting pressure. Crafted with therapeutic contoured Tempur Material memory foam, designed to conform to your shape to relieve tailbone pain and correct back posture. Removable mesh cover is machine washable.

name: Anker 3-in-1 Foldable Charging Station Cube
description: A compact charging hub for your Apple ecosystem. Includes a 15W Max MagSafe-certified fast charger for iPhone, a fold-out magnetic charging pad for Apple Watch, and a wireless charging bed for AirPods.

name: iHome Smart LED Vanity Magnification Makeup Mirror
description: Perfect cosmetics lighting. Features double-sided 1x/10x magnification mirror glass with full-spectrum surround LED ring lights. Adjust light warmth from warm amber to natural daylight. Connects via Bluetooth to stream audio.
